description: List a project's environment variables: names, whether each is secret or a build variable, non-secret values, and update times. Secret values are write-only and are never returned. `rebuildRequired: true` means the live image was built with other build variables: call deploy_project to rebuild. `revision` is the saved env revision and `serving` says which revision the active release runs: when `serving.matchesSaved` is false (after a save without apply, or a rollback to a release that keeps its original env), the live app does not yet see the saved values.
name: list_env
